import re

with open('/app/src/sql/parser/lexer.rs', 'r') as f:

# Replace Display for Token
content = re.sub(
    r'impl Display for Token \{[^}]+fn fmt\([^)]+\) \{[^}]+todo!\(\)[^}]+\}',
    '''impl Display for Token {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Token::Number(n) => write!(f, "{}", n),
            Token::String(s) => write!(f, "'{}'", s),
            Token::Ident(i) => write!(f, "{}", i),
            Token::Keyword(k) => write!(f, "{}", k),
            Token::Period => write!(f, "."),
            Token::Equal => write!(f, "="),
            Token::NotEqual => write!(f, "!="),
            Token::GreaterThan => write!(f, ">"),
            Token::GreaterThanOrEqual => write!(f, ">="),
            Token::LessThan => write!(f, "<"),
            Token::LessThanOrEqual => write!(f, "<="),
            Token::LessOrGreaterThan => write!(f, "<>"),
            Token::Plus => write!(f, "+"),
            Token::Minus => write!(f, "-"),
            Token::Asterisk => write!(f, "*"),
            Token::Slash => write!(f, "/"),
            Token::Caret => write!(f, "^"),
            Token::Percent => write!(f, "%"),
            Token::Exclamation => write!(f, "!"),
            Token::Question => write!(f, "?"),
            Token::Comma => write!(f, ","),
            Token::Semicolon => write!(f, ";"),
            Token::OpenParen => write!(f, "("),
            Token::CloseParen => write!(f, ")"),
        }
    }
}''',
    content,
    flags=re.DOTALL
)

# Replace From<Keyword> for Token
content = re.sub(
    r'impl From<Keyword> for Token \{[^}]+fn from\([^)]+\) \{[^}]+todo!\(\)[^}]+\}',
    '''impl From<Keyword> for Token {
    fn from(keyword: Keyword) -> Self {
        Token::Keyword(keyword)
    }
}''',
    content,
    flags=re.DOTALL
)

with open('/app/src/sql/parser/lexer.rs', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Replaced Display and From implementations")
